purpose: Small community-reference notes for PEva. The current in-game UI takes precedence.

facts.text: Headquarters upgrades are normally gated by building requirements. Check the in-game requirement panel for the exact level because requirements can change by level and version.
If you will be away, it is usually useful to keep building, research and troop-training queues busy. Check the active event before spending speedups.
Alliance coordination and Help can reduce timers or support allies, but PEva should ask what the player needs rather than claim an action was sent.
Before a risky fight, check hospital capacity and the battle report first. PEva must not promise combat results or claim troops were moved.
Resource gathering and city upgrades are long-term choices. Check the current event and your stock before using items; the game screen is the source of truth for costs and rewards.
